title: A support agent for club members
teaser: An Agentforce agent that answers member questions around the clock.
body: We built a structured knowledge base on memberships, class schedules and club rules, and connected it to an Agentforce agent that answers member questions around the clock.
result: routine member questions are handled by the agent; staff only take the cases it hands over.

title: One client picture for every adviser
teaser: An insurance scan in which advisers build client profiles and monitor risks over time.
body: For a franchise chain of financial advisers we developed an insurance scan: an application in which advisers build client profiles and monitor the risks each client runs over time.
result: every franchisee works from the same client picture, and risks show up before they become a problem.

title: One compliance basis in 22 EU languages
teaser: Security and privacy documentation, retention periods and CE/RED instructions for a fleet-tracking SaaS company.
body: For a fleet-tracking SaaS company we rewrote the information security and privacy statement, set retention periods for location data, and prepared CE/RED safety and compliance instructions for its trackers in 22 EU languages.
result: one documented compliance basis for customers, dealers and tenders.
